correctness.rationale: For 0<p_i<1 and kappa>0, strictly positive local raising/lowering jumps yield a unique full-rank stationary state. Explicit stationary balance equations reconstruct all matrix entries, giving |rho_10,01|=|d|sqrt(z(1-z)), P11=q^2-d^2 z, P00=(1-q)^2-d^2z, z=(1+t^2)^-1. Wootters concurrence is positive iff F(z)=-h^2+2d^2(1-h)z-d^2(1+d^2)z^2>0. Its one interior maximum is positive iff d^2>h^2/(1-2h), and negative F(0), F(1) force exactly one finite bounded t interval. Balanced-bath factorization proves the stated square-root window exactly. Numerical checker independently builds and solves the actual physical 16x16 Liouvillian and Wootters spin-flip concurrence (350 random trials), but universal proof is algebraic.

value.rationale: A large static coherence does not imply entanglement. The result provides a complete sharp existence/no-existence criterion in reservoir occupation space, a bounded open exchange-strength operating interval and exact square-root onset at physically natural complementary reservoir occupations, answering when reservoir bias can engineer unconditional entangled steady states. It is a substantive phase boundary rather than a numerical example or trivial no-go at equal baths.
